text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Phew...
Oh my, look at the time already.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (The gym's closing soon, but—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it.
Shion-san is still here at this hour today too—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, she seems to be pushing herself
even harder than before...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I should bring them some refreshments?
I don't want them to feel pressured, though,
so nothing too extravagant—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Let's see, maybe I can casually offer some of their favorite snacks—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, Verxina-san.
It's almost closing time for the gym.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
Oh my!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haha... That's kinda rare.
Usually, I'm the one who gets called over
by Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No, I was just lost in thought...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
A LANE message... from Big Sis, huh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (..."I wonder what kind of cake Shion-san likes?")

text_block_list.name: Cheval's LANE
text_block_list.text: "Why do you ask?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina's LANE
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, I'm just a little curious."
"Right? Won't you tell me?"
"Ah! Keep this a secret from Shion-san, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval's LANE
text_block_list.text: "(Sticker of a meat bun character looking troubled)"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"She seems to like apples,
so maybe an apple cake, or something...?"
...Right. Hehe... thanks, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I see. Then how about we go buy a cake from that patisserie I recommend—hm?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I love apples, yes! I love them, but...!
I love them so much it makes me feel unworthy, or something...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The better the apple is,
the more it's... gah!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I remember now.
She did say something like that...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, will it only make them worry more...?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (I might as well just make it myself.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (If it's just something handmade by an amateur, they won't feel obligated or anything—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I can easily make up an excuse like,
"I accidentally made too much—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Wait, Shion?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san?!
W-Well... Wh-What a coincidence~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I never expected Shion-san to be using
the dorm kitchen...! Maybe I should
come back later...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Those sweets you are making, Shion-san...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Could it perhaps be
a 'Victoria Sponge'?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's such a lovely cake, isn't it?
Delicious, and so elegant.
I've loved that cake ever since I was little—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Well, the truth is...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Sweets that Big sis likes... is it...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Verxina-san's been pushing herself really hard lately...
So I kind of wanted to casually bring her some refreshments—!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu...! Ah, no.
That's not what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "I just couldn't help it once I realized how much we're really cut from the same cloth."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Two of a kind...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, really...
They look shockingly alike.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina and Win Variation often
do voluntary training together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They must have been training hard together today as well.
I spotted them having a fun break beside the track,
enjoying some snacks together.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer,
hello there.
choice_data_list: I brought refreshments for both of you!
It's nice to have a training buddy you get along with.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Trainer...!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, looks like you and Verxina-san get along great, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's a bit of a long story, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Why don't we enjoy some
apple tart and Victoria sponge while we talk?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. We hit it off surprisingly well.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, totally!
It's almost like we get along a little *too* well.
choice_data_list: Please keep looking out for Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No way, it's actually me
who's always being looked after by you, Verxina-san...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"What are you saying...!
I'm the one who's always relying on you, Shion-san—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as I watched the two of them endlessly praise one another,
I found myself thinking once more just how truly well-matched they were...
